models.evidence: 7-word hardcoded vocabulary, 7-dim output. Introduced alongside SimpleLLMBackend in commit ea97355 to replace mock ablation engine. Never described as 'baseline' or 'production' in any commit message or protocol document.

Used via RealEmbeddingModel(SentenceTransformer) in 11+ experiment scripts. Named in experiment manifests: fusion-evaluation-v3-real/manifest.json and fusion-evaluation-v3-confirmed/manifest.json. Produces 768-dim vectors matching docs/ARCHITECTURE.md VECTOR(768) specification.
Evaluated as alternative to S-PubMedBert-MS-MARCO in biomedical fusion experiment.
Listed as dependency >=6.0.1 in pyproject.toml. Used by experiment scripts but NOT by the orchestrator baseline retrieval path or live_variants.py.
